sloka: पल्वलानि तटाकानि सराम्सि सरितः तथा ।नद्यो अनूपवन अन्ताः च दुर्गाः च धरणी धराः ॥५-१३-४॥
transliteration: palvalāni taṭākāni sarāmsi saritaḥ tathā ।nadyo anūpavana antāḥ ca durgāḥ ca dharaṇī dharāḥ ॥5-13-4॥

translations.english: "I have searched for Sita thoroughly in waterlogs, lakes, tanks, streams and rivers and all over the woods and among mountains that are difficult to reach. I have searched all over the land but have not been able to find Janaki.
translations.hindi: गात्र के वन से म्रांच्छादित और सैकड़ों लताग्रों से वेष्टित उस श्रशोक वाटिका में रोदा से छुटे हुए तीर की तरह, हनुमानजी उछल कर जा पहुंचे
